literal_meaning: গাল (অপবাদ বা গালি) + গল্প (কথা বা কাহিনি)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গালগল্প শুনে কেউ বিশ্বাস করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Nobody believes his cock and bull stories.
That's just a tall tale, not the truth.
note: Refers to everyday Bengali oral traditions of storytelling with embellishments.
